title: Outer Ring Road
draft: Claude's draft 2026-10-17 from story_script_v1 §6 (3.1: night, scooter, Hebbal junction, a bike swerves, the other rider is Ravi asleep at the handlebars after a 20-hour shift — 'coincidence motivated: he caused it'; same ambulance, same ward), ADR-09 (sell the contrivance with the Outer Ring Road night texture), ADR-11 (interiors never shown become reveals — the HIVR site stays a card), outbreak_origin_v1 §6 (the player's firm builds HIVR's sample tracker; AMR-07 from 2.7), 1.2 (Ravi's green lanyard), ADR-19 (stress). The user edits the words and the numbers; then P17 builds it.
time: The morning after Act 2 ends (the first sleep after act2_done): a workday that ends at the HIVR site in Hebbal; the ride home at 23:40
player_goal: Fix AMR-07 at the client site; ride home on the Outer Ring Road.
design_goal: Conflict (Act 3 opens): the routine ends in one second at a junction. The coincidence is motivated twice over — the AMR-07 thread put you at Hebbal at night; twenty hours of unpaid work put Ravi asleep at the handlebars. The player learns who the other rider is from one detail (the green lanyard from 1.2). No fight, no blame on screen, no gore: a card, a light, a sound cut, black.

cast.role: Morning, at the lobby: 'The HIVR people want someone on site for AMR-07. Today. You built half that screen, you go. Take the evening, come in late tomorrow.' She looks tired; she doesn't say why.
Not seen awake. In the ambulance, the other stretcher: a green lanyard over the edge, a phone buzzing in the pocket ('Appa'). The player knows before anyone says it.

beats.what: The first morning after Act 2: an ACT 3 — FEVER title card. Divya's chat at 08:10: 'Come by the lobby before you start.' (News that morning: 'Hebbal: second ward closed; officials say situation under control.')

The office gate: Divya at the lobby sends you to the HIVR site for AMR-07. The day passes on a card like the workday, but in Hebbal: 'HIVR · Visitor block. A cold server room, a guard who checks your bag twice, a tracker log where AMR-07's status was overwritten at 02:14 on a rainy Thursday by a user called night_ops. You write it down. Nobody wants to hear it.' (clue_amr07_time). It's 23:30 when you leave.

The ride home on the Outer Ring Road — a card, not a ride: 'ORR · 23:52. Hebbal junction. The signal blinks amber. A bike comes down off the flyover too fast, no lights. The rider's head is down.' One beat of white (reduced motion: no flash, the card just cuts), the HUD drops away, black. No sound. (No scooter? Sameer lent you his bike that morning — 'bring it back with the mirror on'.)

Black, then fragments as text, slow: '…two of them…' · '…same ambulance, no time…' · a siren · the other stretcher: a green lanyard hanging over the edge, a phone buzzing — APPA — until someone silences it. Fade to Ward 4 (3.2).
